meta.name: volta-3-0-components
meta.title: Volta 3.0 Components
meta.description: Creates implementation-ready design-system guidance derived from local Figma styles in "Volta 3.0 Components".

guidelines.mission: Document and operationalize the Volta 3.0 Components style foundations extracted from Figma so teams can build consistent interfaces quickly.
brand: Audience: Designers and engineers building this product
rulesDo: Use extracted color tokens before introducing one-off values: avatar-1, avatar-2, avatar-3, avatar-4, avatar-5, avatar-6.
Use these typography styles consistently: Tailwind/XS/Light, Tailwind/XS/Regular, Tailwind/XS/Medium, Tailwind/XS/Semi Bold, Tailwind/XS/Bold, Tailwind/SM/Light.
Define all interaction states for interactive components: default, hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, and loading.
rulesDont: Do not duplicate existing style tokens with one-off naming.
Do not remove focus-visible indicators or keyboard support.
Do not hard-code raw values where local styles or variables already exist.
componentRules: Include keyboard, pointer, and touch behavior.
Include spacing and typography token requirements.
Include long-content, overflow, and empty-state handling.
qualityGates: Every accessibility rule is testable in implementation.
Prefer system consistency over local visual exceptions.

issues.summary: Conflicting tokens for the same CSS variable (first by path wins)
